Starting from Sarah:
- Sarah → Jennifer (ancestor)
- Jennifer → Ronald (ancestor)
- Ronald → Roger (ancestor)
- Roger → Jesse (descendant)
- Jesse → Julie (descendant)
- Julie → Billy (descendant)
- Billy → Patrick (ancestor)
- Patrick → Rachel (ancestor)

**Sarah is an ancestor of Rachel.**

## Tracing Tyler's Descendants

Starting from Tyler:
- Tyler → Zachary → Julia → Michael → Noah → Megan → Diane → Gary → Dorothy → Judy → Kimberly → Maria → Bradley → Roy → Thomas → Amy → Alexis → Carol → Diana → Janet → James → Mason → Brandon → Andrea → Scott → Joshua → Gabriel → Hannah → Jeffrey → Andrew → Walter → Martha → Carl → Paul → Kayla → Jason → Wayne → Olivia → Evelyn → Ashley → Keith → Albert → Arthur → Ralph → Donald → Joyce → Lisa → Gregory → Elijah → Ethan → Harold → Justin → Ruth → Matthew → Kathryn → Juan → Edward → Sean → Mark → Abigail → Katherine → Emily → Angela → Victoria → Robert → Linda → Brittany → Mary → Anthony → Lawrence → Gloria → Nicholas → Bobby → Kathleen → Jeremy → Frances → Cheryl → Brian → Virginia → Richard → Debra → Joseph → Sara → Barbara → Jessica → Beverly → Karen → Randy → Michelle → Vincent → Laura → Bruce → Sandra → Brenda → Denise → Timothy → Charlotte → Russell → Raymond → Samantha → Donna → Joan → Carolyn → Jordan → Kevin → Bryan → Doris → Grace → Christine → Susan → Jonathan → Christian → Aaron → Ann → Stephen → Catherine → Joe → Janice → Nancy → **Rachel**

**Tyler is also an ancestor of Rachel.**

## Conclusion

Both Sarah and Tyler are ancestors of **Rachel**, but neither is an ancestor or descendant of the other. They converge at Rachel as a common descendant.
